findings.title: Null becomes assign
findings.body:
The `or {}` fallback turns an identity entry whose value is `None` into `{}`. In ARM PATCH semantics, `{"<identityId>": null}` means "remove this user-assigned identity", while `{"<identityId>": {}}` means "assign/keep it".

Before this change, a `None` entry was dropped, which was a no-op for that identity. After it, the same input actively assigns the identity. If any caller builds a PATCH payload with `None` values to detach identities, that request now does the opposite.

Suggested fix: keep `None` values as they are, or drop them. Only replace dicts that become empty after cleaning, for example by checking `isinstance(properties, dict)` before applying the `{}` fallback.

Uncertain: I could not see whether any current call site passes `None` values for removal.
